S1037.reason: An assignee of a real estate purchase contract can generally seek specific performance, and the zoning change does not bar it since the buyer can waive the title defect.

S0107.reason: Personal immunity attaches to a person in their personal capacity and does not cover State conduct as such.

S0341.reason: Normal adult respiratory rate is commonly cited as around 12-16 breaths per minute, matching option D.
